levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Every main item has a rating or is marked as not done. The extra items in the dropdowns and the comments are optional and do not change the score.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: At least half of the main items are rated or marked as not done.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Fewer than half of the main items are rated or marked as not done.

criterion: Rate The Rotation: Every main item is rated or skipped

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: All three big-picture sliders are set and at least one of the three written questions has an answer. What the answers say does not change the score.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Some of the big picture is answered, but a slider is unset or nothing is written.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Nothing in the big picture is answered.

criterion: The Big Picture: The big picture is answered
